resources.string: "Mount the phone on a steady stand, somewhat high and angled toward the road, and don\'t move it at all after calibration. "
"Any movement afterwards throws off the distance between the lines, and therefore the speed."
"No stability reference saved yet. You\'ll save it in the last step."
"If the camera views the road at an angle, perspective mapping gives more accurate speeds and tells lanes apart. "
"If the camera looks straight down on the road, or you\'ll measure a single lane, tap \"Skip\"."
"Start measuring with the \"Start\" button below and drive past with a car whose speed you know. You need at least 3 samples at different speeds. "
"You can skip this step and rely on the theoretical calculation, but accuracy will be lower."
"Perspective is on, distance between the lines %1$s {dst}"
"The lines are too close together: move them apart (step 2)"
"No speed samples, accuracy is theoretical only (step 4)"
"Too few samples (%1$s). Add up to at least 3 (step 4)"
"You haven\'t saved a stability reference yet. Tap the button below."
"Save the reference after you finish calibrating, with the camera in its final position and, if possible, without many vehicles in view."
"The camera is the only measurement source. No photos are saved except evidence shots of speeding vehicles (you can turn this off in Settings)."
"Model file not found⏎Put efficientdet_lite0.tflite or vehicles_custom.tflite in app/src/main/assets"
"Watches motion at the two lines at camera speed, and the model only identifies the type at the moment of crossing. Best with one direction and a steady phone."
"A vehicle is counted as soon as it crosses either line (no speed calculation)."
"The image changed from the reference (rotation/different camera). Save a new reference."
"The camera moved about %1$s%% of the image width, so the calibration may no longer be valid"
"The phone is shaking, mount it more firmly"
"%1$s. A backup copy was saved. Resume measuring once the device cools down or is charged."
"%1$s. Consider cooling the device down or plugging in a charger."
"No.,Date,Time,Hour,Vehicle type,Speed ({spd}),Direction,Plate,Plate letters,Plate digits,Reading confidence %%,Speed confidence %%,Error margin ± ({spd}),Lane"
"Too few GPS samples around the pass"
"GPS recording started. Keep the screen on and the app in the foreground."
"Turn on GPS (location) on the phone and try again."
"Locating the camera... wait up to 40 seconds (in an open area)."
"Couldn\'t get an accurate enough location. Go somewhere open and try again."
"No pass near the camera location in this file ({dst:80} radius)."
"Instead of typing samples by hand: a second phone inside the car records GPS speed, and the app matches each pass with its measurement and adds it to the calibration. "
"Both phones must have their time set automatically from the network."
"1) On the reference phone (inside the car)"
"File %1$s was saved to Downloads. Move it to the camera phone."
"The recording was too short or saving failed."
"Current average difference between the app and GPS: "
"%1$s samples added to the calibration. See your device\'s accuracy in the speed calibration card."
"Important: the raw speed is computed by reversing your current calibration, so don\'t change the calibration between measuring and matching. "
"If your current calibration isn\'t zero-error, it\'s best to reset it before doing the measurement run."
"GPS speed accuracy is usually about ±{spd:1} in an open area. An accepted pass must have a steady speed above {spd:15} and no other vehicle close in time."
"Use perspective mapping (removes the speed difference between lanes)"
"1) Mark 4 points on the road (e.g. 4 cones) at the corners of a rectangle: two parallel lines spanning the whole road.⏎"
"2) Measure the distance between the lines along the road and enter it below.⏎"
"3) Drag points 1 and 2 onto the first line (A) and points 4 and 3 onto the second line (B), each opposite its counterpart."
"Adjust the points from the Camera tab ← \"Perspective\" button."
"Real distance between lines A and B along the road ({dst})"
"⚠ The points don\'t form a valid quadrilateral (it must be convex and not skewed). Fix them; until then the app uses the regular lines."
"✓ Perspective mapping is on. Speed is computed on the ground from line A to line B, so near and far lanes get the same accuracy."
"Leave it at 0 if unsure. Distortion affects the edges, so it\'s easiest to keep lines A and B in the middle two thirds of the image. "
"If you found better accuracy at a certain value when calibrating with a car of known speed, use it."
"Every passing vehicle has its plate recorded with its speed on the same row."
"Couldn\'t prepare the language data for plate reading. Check your internet and try again (or put %1$s in app/src/main/assets and reinstall)."
"Ready. Plates are read better when the camera is close to the vehicles and with \"High resolution\" turned on in Settings."
"Downloading the plate-reading language data (one time only, a few MB)..."
"Start measuring from the Camera tab and every passing vehicle will show up here with its plate and speed."
"All readings (speeds and plates) will be permanently deleted."
"No vehicle found in the image. Try rotating the image or choose \"Close-up plate image\"."
"Pick an image from the gallery (a whole vehicle or a close-up plate) and see what the app reads and where it goes wrong. "
"The closer and clearer the image, the better the reading."
"The language data isn\'t ready yet (turn on plate reading above and wait for the download, or put %1$s in assets)."
"Rejected (confidence below 35 or the text doesn\'t match the selected plate format)"
"Speed Radar is running in the background"
"At night the camera slows its frame rate to let in more light, which ruins crossing timing. Here you can lock the frame rate and control brightness."
"Exposure compensation will appear once the camera starts."
"The camera on your device doesn\'t support manual exposure. Use the lock and compensation instead."
"Shutter speed (faster = clearer for moving vehicles but darker)"
"If the image is black, raise the ISO or slow the shutter. At night, try 1/250 and ISO 1600 first."
"Measure the difference by testing: the real FPS is shown in the Camera tab, so compare day and night."
"Keep running in the background (continues with the screen off)"
"Starts a service with a persistent notification that has a stop button. Start measuring with the app visible, then you can turn the screen off. "
"It\'s best to plug the device into a charger and mount it somewhere ventilated."
"Open the battery settings manually and allow the app to run in the background"
"Warning at 42° or battery at 20%%, and automatic stop (with a backup copy) at 46° or battery at 7%% when not charging."
"When the count passes the limit, the oldest records are saved to a speedcam_archive_… file in Downloads and then removed from the app (along with their shots)."
"Number of lanes per direction (for lanes and level of service)"
"One-way road\? Allowed direction (any vehicle going against it is logged)"
"Congestion alert if the median speed of the last 6 vehicles is below ({spd})"
"Instant alert if a vehicle\'s speed reaches ({spd})"
"Events are logged in the Statistics tab and a notification is sent (notification permission required). Each notification type repeats at most once a minute. "
"Note: stopped-vehicle detection relies on the tracker seeing the vehicle, so a very distant or hidden vehicle may not be detected."
"Supported: MJPEG streaming over HTTP on the same network (many IP cameras, or an old phone running a camera-streaming app). The path differs from camera to camera, so check its manual. "
"You can include the username and password in the URL: http://user:pass\@address/path."
"Accuracy note: each frame\'s timestamp is when it reached the phone, not when it was captured, and the network adds jittery delay, so speed accuracy is lower than with the phone camera. "
"Use strong Wi-Fi or a cable, then calibrate with a car of known speed. RTSP and USB cameras are not supported at the moment."
"Exposure, FPS and night lighting are set on the camera itself, and infrared lighting is a camera feature, not an app feature."
"Perspective mapping is on: lines A and B are defined by the four points (the \"Perspective\" button in the Camera tab)."
"Direction of vehicle movement in the image"
"⚠ The lines are too close together, move them apart for better accuracy"
"Real distance between the lines on the ground ({dst})"
"Drive past with a car at a steady, known speed from the speedometer or GPS, and enter the real speed and the app\'s reading as shown, "
"then tap \"Add sample\". Repeat at different speeds (e.g. 30, 50 and 70): from three or more well-spaced samples "
"the app computes two coefficients (scale and offset). Calibration applies to new measurements only."
"Add at least 3 samples (at different speeds) so your device\'s accuracy can be computed."
"Fast mode: timing uses camera frames directly (no vehicle tracking), so these numbers are higher than in normal mode."
"To measure {spd:80} at ±10%% accuracy you need at least %1$s {dst} between the lines."
"By the statistical formula (relative error = √2 × σ × speed ÷ distance): for {spd:80} at ±5%% you need %1$s {dst}, and at ±10%% you need %2$s {dst}."
" A theoretical estimate; actual accuracy is confirmed by testing with a car of known speed."
"Tell microbuses and tuk-tuks apart by size (ready-made model only)"
"Estimates the vehicle length from the calibration. Works when movement is horizontal and the whole vehicle is in the frame. "
"If you use a custom model (vehicles_custom.tflite), this is ignored automatically."
"GPU-accelerated detection (turn off if you have problems)"
"Save a shot of every vehicle exceeding the speed limit"
"The shot is saved inside the app only (not in the photo gallery), appears in the Vehicles tab and you can share it. "
"Keeps the last 300 shots and automatically deletes the oldest, and they\'re deleted when you delete the measurement itself. "
"You set the speed limit from the Vehicles tab."
"Mount the phone on a steady stand and let vehicles pass across its view. Mark two points on the ground, measure the distance between them, "
"and align the two yellow lines with them. Test with a car whose speed you know from the speedometer before you rely on the numbers."
"The app automatically saves a copy of all measurements every 10 minutes in the Downloads folder as speedcam_backup plus today\'s date, and it opens in Excel."
"No suitable app found on the device"
"%1$s has been stopped in view for more than %2$s seconds"
"%1$s is going against the allowed direction"
"Exclude outlier readings (more than 3 × MAD from the median)"
"Start measuring from the Camera tab and the statistics will appear here."
"V85: the speed below which 85%% of vehicles travel, a common benchmark in traffic studies."
" (%1$s outlier readings were excluded from the speed calculation)"
"Showing the latest 48 periods; the exported report contains all of them."
"Peak 15 minutes: needs at least 15 minutes of measurement."
"Peak hour factor: needs at least one hour of measurement."
"Time gap between vehicles: average %1$s s • median %2$s s • %3$s%% under two seconds"
"Lane counts appear once you turn on perspective mapping."
"Notes: PCE uses indicative values (car 1, microbus 1.5, tuk-tuk 0.8, motorcycle 0.4, bus and truck 2). "
"Level of service is a preliminary estimate from the flow-to-capacity ratio using common thresholds, and is not a substitute for a full HCM calculation. "
"Lanes are assumed equally wide across the marked road, and flow is over the actual measurement period (it\'s lower if measurement was stopped)."
"No events recorded. Turn on alerts in Settings (wrong-way, stopped vehicle, congestion, very high speed)."
" along with their evidence shots, and this can\'t be undone. If you want a copy, export to Excel first."
"The vehicle recorded at %1$s will be deleted along with its evidence shot (if any)."
"Every vehicle that appeared on the camera, with speeders in red"
"Any vehicle faster than ({spd}) shows in red"
"Excludes readings with confidence below %1$s%% (tracking was weak or the box was jittering)."
"%1$s readings are over the limit but within the error margin (unconfirmed)"
"\"Delete displayed\" removes what\'s shown under the current filter (speeders or reliable only). There\'s also a delete button on each vehicle."
"Change the speed limit or show all vehicles."
"Start measuring from the Camera tab and every passing vehicle will show up here."
"Showing the latest %1$s of %2$s — export includes all."
" • over the limit but within the error margin"
"The image doesn\'t exist (it may have been deleted automatically because the app keeps only the last 300 shots)."
"Record a video of the road with the phone camera from the same mounting position, and analyze it here as many times as you like, trying any change in Settings "
"(lines, distance, calibration) on the same video. The analysis uses the same detection and tracking, and doesn\'t record anything in the database."
"The first line (orange) and the second (green) are in the same place as in Settings. Adjust them from the calibration card above until they match the two measurement marks on the ground."
"Frames analyzed per second (simulates your device\'s speed)"
"Detection time %1$s ms per frame, so your device can analyze about %2$s frames/s (from detection time only)."
"No complete crossing was measured. Make sure the lines are on the vehicles\' path, that vehicles cross both lines, and that the distance between them is correct."
"If all vehicles in the video travel at the same known speed, the error percentage shows for each measurement, and you can add any measurement as a calibration sample."
"Choose your country\'s plate format so misreads are filtered out. The first time you pick a format that uses a new language, a small data file is downloaded."
"The vehicle is too small in the image"
"The plate was located automatically and read on the first attempt."
"The plate wasn\'t located automatically, so the whole crop was read."
"Reading from the located plate wasn\'t clear, so the full crop was tried too."
"Electronic stabilization crops and warps frames and shifts timing. It isn\'t needed on a fixed mount."
"Autofocus can hunt when a vehicle passes and blur the shot. Aim the camera at the road and tap \"Focus now\"."
"Set the zoom before calibrating: changing it afterwards invalidates the calibration. Focus is re-set after each change."
"Full HD 1080p (clearer plates, heavier on the phone)"
"Image too dark: raise brightness or ISO, or slow the shutter"
"Image over-exposed: lower brightness or use a faster shutter"
"Image isn\'t sharp: tap Focus now, clean the lens, and check for shaking"

"Drive past the camera several times at a steady, known speed (from the speedometer or GPS). Each pass is captured automatically and compared with the known speed. Change the known speed between runs (for example 30, 50 and 70) for a better calibration."
"Recording passes... drive past at a steady speed. Start measuring from the Camera tab if it isn\'t running."
"%1$s readings were ignored (low confidence or far from the known speed, probably another vehicle)."
"Need at least 3 passes to compute accuracy."
"%1$s passes • mean error %2$s {spd} • spread (SD) %3$s {spd} • 95%% of readings within ±%4$s {spd}"
"Accuracy is good: no consistent bias and the readings are tight."
"A consistent bias of %1$s%%. Add these passes as calibration samples to correct it."
"The readings are scattered (SD %1$s%%). Move the two lines farther apart, raise the FPS, improve light and focus, or add more passes."
"%1$s samples were added to the calibration. Run the test again to verify."

"The model downsizes the whole frame to a small square, so far vehicles end up tiny. Cropping to the road area gives it more detail at the same cost. The cyan dashed frame on the camera view shows the zone. Make sure vehicles stay fully inside it while crossing the two lines."
"Detection runs on the whole frame (no extra detail)."
"Zone covers %1$s%% of the frame: about ×%2$s more detail on vehicles."
"Scale check: cars measure about %1$s {dst} long (expected about %2$s {dst}). The distance between the lines looks right."

"Scale check: cars measure about %1$s {dst} (expected about %2$s {dst}, %3$s%% off). The distance between the lines may be wrong: try about %4$s {dst}, or check that the camera and zoom did not move."
"Cars measure %1$s {dst} (expected about %2$s): check the line distance"
"Lens distortion correction by the camera (best quality)"

"Wide lenses bend straight lines near the edges, which skews distances. This asks the phone to straighten the image before analysis. It may lower the frame rate on some phones, so check the FPS after turning it on, and re-check the calibration."

"Saves frames from your street together with the detector\'s boxes, so you can correct them and train a model that knows your local vehicles (tuk-tuks, microbuses...). The boxes are automatic guesses: review them before training. Images may show people and license plates: keep them private and follow local privacy laws. Collection runs only while measuring is on, and nothing leaves the phone unless you export it."
